data.body:
[operator-attested] EVIDENCE for AC3 and AC4. Both are attested because their proof is an
execution/audit record rather than a repository artifact.

LANDED: Gerrit change 1678, "Stop main() test reading the real gate ref", MERGED with
LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. The Verified vote is CI's own run of `make lint`, `make
typecheck` and the full suite against this patchset, so AC4 has an independent external
witness in addition to the local runs below. For the record, patchset 1 was rebased (not
rechecked) after its sibling change hit a stale-base failure in the complexity-baseline lock
gate, on a function neither change touches; `check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reports
`active=60 new=0 increased=0 stale=0` on the landed base.

AC3 — audit, widened beyond the single file the criterion asked about.

Command: grep for `delenv("REBAR_ROOT"` across `tests/`, then for each hit grep for
`read_pause|check_pass_lock|refs/reconciler|advisory`.

Result: eleven test files clear `REBAR_ROOT` — `test_opcert_service_integrity_heldout.py`,
`test_opcert_service.py`, `test_reviewbot_ensure_tickets.py`, `test_config_ev3a_aliases.py`,
`test_config_loader.py`, `test_ensures_boot_budget_e43f.py`, `test_config_tracker_dir.py`,
`test_config_perf.py`, `reviewbot_convergence_support.py`,
`test_no_sys_exit_in_read_core_176d.py`, `test_mcp_survives_non_repo_root_176d.py` — and
`test_reconcile_main.py`. Of those, `test_reconcile_main.py` is the ONLY one that also enters
the advisory/gate path. The single other grep hit is an unrelated `"advisory": []` JSON key
in `test_reviewbot_ensure_tickets.py:187`, not the advisory-lock module.

Within `test_reconcile_main.py` there are no sibling tests to convert: exactly one test
cleared `REBAR_ROOT` before this change, and the only other `read_pause` reference already
patched it. Nothing further to change — the audit's outcome is "no other sites", not "other
sites fixed".

AC4 — RED/GREEN and gates, run locally on the committed tree.

RED, produced by removing ONLY the `read_pause` stub line from `_stub_main_advisory` on a
working copy (the fix reverted, the tests kept):

    test_main_resolves_repo_root_even_when_the_ambient_gate_ref_is_corrupt
      -> AssertionError: a corrupt ambient refs/reconciler/gate must not stop main()
         reaching the preflight; read_pause is stubbed precisely so this test cannot read
         the enclosing repo's refs
    test_main_without_repo_root_passes_resolved_repo_root
      -> AssertionError: read_pause must be called before the preflight
    2 failed, 12 passed

The second failure is the CI symptom's mechanism reproduced deterministically: without the
stub, `main()` returns from `_pause_exit_code` before `_post_pause_preflight`.

GREEN, stub restored: `14 passed`. Reconciler unit tree: `2409 passed`. Gates:
`ruff check -> All checks passed!`, `ruff format --check -> 1929 files already formatted`,
`mypy src/rebar scripts -> Success: no issues found in 511 source files`. `make config-check`
and `pre-commit run --all-files` also pass.
